nodes.name: Greater Will
nodes.base_description: The Greater Will is an ambiguous Outer God that appears to be a cosmic parasite. Its influence is represented by golden light ('grace').

nodes.name: Queen Marika
nodes.base_description: Queen Marika is a Numen, vassal of the Greater Will, who bears the Elden Ring. She is an Empyrean, given Maliketh as a Shadow. She had consorts Godfrey and Radagon, and children including Godwyn, Morgott, Mohg, Malenia, Miquella, and possibly Melina. She shattered the Elden Ring.

states.current_description: Queen Marika is a Numen vassal of the Greater Will bearing the Elden Ring. She is the wife of Godfrey and has children Godwyn, Morgott, and Mohg. She has not yet married Radagon or shattered the Elden Ring.

Queen Marika is a Numen, former vassal of the Greater Will, who shattered the Elden Ring in defiance after Godwyn's death. She is imprisoned within the Erdtree along with Radagon. She is no longer the active ruler of the Lands Between.

nodes.name: Elden Ring
nodes.base_description: The Elden Ring is the physical manifestation of the Greater Will's power, made up of disparate runes, and the source of the Erdtree's power.

states.current_description: The Elden Ring is intact, the physical manifestation of the Greater Will's power, made up of disparate runes, and the source of the Erdtree's power.
The Elden Ring is shattered into pieces. Its runes are scattered and held by various demigods. The Greater Will's influence is fading.

nodes.name: Two Fingers
nodes.base_description: The Two Fingers are literal emissaries that try to enact the desires of the Greater Will.

nodes.name: Golden Order
nodes.base_description: The Golden Order is a human system of beliefs that helps enact the Greater Will's desires.

nodes.name: Lands Between
nodes.base_description: The Lands Between is the main setting, first ruled by dragons, later by Marika and the Golden Order.

nodes.name: Dragonlord Placidusax
nodes.base_description: Dragonlord Placidusax is the former lord of the dragons who ruled the Lands Between.

nodes.name: dragons
nodes.base_description: The dragons were the first rulers of the Lands Between, led by Dragonlord Placidusax, allied with an unnamed Outer God.

nodes.name: Erdtree
nodes.base_description: The Erdtree is the great tree that serves as the source of power from the Elden Ring. It is tied to the Greater Will and absorbs beings who visit it, presumably into the Greater Will. Its primordial form was the 'crucible' of life.

states.current_description: The Erdtree in its primordial form was the 'crucible' of life, where those born with horns or tails were seen as blessed.

The Erdtree has been transformed from its primordial crucible form. It now serves the Golden Order and the Greater Will, absorbing beings who visit it. Those born with signs of the crucible are now seen as cursed.

nodes.name: Haligtree
nodes.base_description: The Haligtree is an artificial Erdtree created by Miquella after he rejected the Golden Order. It serves as a refuge for those discriminated against by the Golden Order (Albinaurics, Misbegotten, etc.) and was created to search for a cure for Malenia's scarlet rot.

states.current_description: The Haligtree is an artificial Erdtree created by Miquella as a refuge for the discriminated and to cure Malenia. It is separate from and opposes the Golden Order's Erdtree.

nodes.name: Elden Beast
nodes.base_description: The Elden Beast is a vassal of the Greater Will sent within a star, later absorbed into Queen Marika's body.

nodes.name: Numen
nodes.base_description: The Numen are a race that originated outside the Lands Between; Queen Marika is descended from them.

nodes.name: Leyndell
nodes.base_description: Leyndell is the capital established by Marika after becoming the Greater Will's vassal.

nodes.name: Godwyn the Golden
nodes.base_description: Godwyn is Marika's son, befriended the dragon Fortissax. He was killed during the Night of the Black Knives, later worshiped as the Prince of Death.

states.current_description: Godwyn the Golden is Marika's living son, who befriended the dragon Fortissax. He is alive and well.
Godwyn the Golden is dead. His body is entwined with the roots of the Erdtree under the capital in Deeproot Depths. He is worshiped as the Prince of Death, and his death causes deathroot to sprout.

nodes.name: Fortissax
nodes.base_description: Fortissax is a dragon befriended by Godwyn.

nodes.name: omens
nodes.base_description: Omens are those born with signs of the crucible (horns, tails). Before the Golden Order it was a blessing, later a curse.

nodes.name: Maliketh
nodes.base_description: Maliketh is Marika's half-brother and Shadow, the keeper of the Rune of Death. He slew the Gloam-Eyed Queen. After the Night of the Black Knives, he became Gurranq.

states.current_description: Maliketh is Marika's half-brother and Shadow, the loyal keeper of the Rune of Death. He slew the Gloam-Eyed Queen. He has not yet been betrayed.

Maliketh, now also known as Gurranq, is Marika's half-brother and Shadow who lost the Rune of Death during the Night of the Black Knives. He takes penance and constantly fights the urge to feed on death, seeking deathroot.

nodes.name: Gloam-Eyed Queen
nodes.base_description: The Gloam-Eyed Queen (also Dusk-Eyed Queen) is a goddess of death, leader of the Godskin Apostles. She held the Rune of Death before Maliketh slew her.

nodes.name: Fire Giants
nodes.base_description: The Fire Giants are followers of the One-Eyed Fell God. Marika waged war on them because of their Forged Flame that could burn the Erdtree.

states.current_description: The Fire Giants are followers of the One-Eyed Fell God, a powerful force with a forge that can burn the Erdtree.
The Fire Giants are nearly extinct. Only one cursed survivor remains, forced to tend the Forge of the Giants for eternity. The Trolls betrayed them and allied with Marika.

nodes.name: Radagon
nodes.base_description: Radagon is a general under Marika, later her second consort. He is the other half of Marika ('Radagon is Marika'). He married Rennala, then left her to marry Marika.

states.current_description: Radagon is a general under Marika. He is married to Rennala of the Carian kingdom and has three children: Radahn, Rykard, and Ranni. He has not yet left Rennala.
Radagon is Marika's second consort and the other half of Marika ('Radagon is Marika'). He left Rennala to marry Marika. He and Marika have children Malenia and Miquella.
Radagon is imprisoned within the Erdtree along with Marika. He attempted to repair the shattered Elden Ring but failed. He is no longer free.

nodes.name: Hoarah Loux
nodes.base_description: Hoarah Loux is a chieftain of the Badlands, a general for Marika who later rebranded as Godfrey. He became the first Tarnished and was banished.

states.current_description: Hoarah Loux is a chieftain of the Badlands and a general serving Marika. He is known as Godfrey, the first Elden Lord, and is married to Marika. He has children Godwyn, Morgott, and Mohg.
Hoarah Loux (Godfrey) is the first Tarnished, banished from the Lands Between. He no longer has the blessing of grace. He later returns as a Tarnished seeking to reclaim his title.

nodes.name: trolls
nodes.base_description: The trolls are beings who betrayed the Fire Giants and allied with Marika. They have holes in their stomachs where the eye of the Fell God used to be.

nodes.name: Morgott
nodes.base_description: Morgott is Marika's son, an Omen twin with Mohg. He was banished but later took over the Capital, remaining a true believer in the Golden Order. Also known as Margit.

states.current_description: Morgott is Marika's son, an Omen twin with Mohg. He is banished due to being born with horns, considered cursed. He is not yet the ruler of Leyndell.
Morgott is the secret ruler of Leyndell, using the alias Margit the Fell when needed. He is a true believer in the Golden Order despite his curse. He defended the Capital during the Shattering.

nodes.name: Mohg
nodes.base_description: Mohg is Marika's son, an Omen twin with Morgott. He resented his banishment and fell into league with the Formless Mother.

states.current_description: Mohg is Marika's son, an Omen twin with Morgott. He resents his banishment and eventually falls into league with the Formless Mother, an Outer God of blood.
Mohg is in league with the Formless Mother. He stole Miquella with the intent of making him a puppet ruler, acting as his consort, but Miquella rejects this.

nodes.name: Nokron
nodes.base_description: Nokron is one of the twin underground cities of the Nox, destroyed by beasts carried on falling stars.

nodes.name: Nokstella
nodes.base_description: Nokstella is one of the twin underground cities of the Nox, destroyed by beasts carried on falling stars.

nodes.name: Nox
nodes.base_description: The Nox are individuals who created the fingerslayer blade and were banished underground for alchemy the Greater Will disapproved of.

nodes.name: Carian kingdom
nodes.base_description: The Carian kingdom is a neighboring kingdom to Leyndell, led by Queen Rennala, known for sorcery.

nodes.name: Queen Rennala
nodes.base_description: Queen Rennala is the leader of the Carian kingdom. She married Radagon and had three children: Radahn, Rykard, and Ranni. After Radagon left, she became a shell of herself.

states.current_description: Queen Rennala is the leader of the Carian kingdom, married to Radagon. She has three children: Radahn, Rykard, and Ranni. She is respected by the Academy of Raya Lucaria.
Queen Rennala is a shell of her former self, locked away after Radagon left her. She was left a piece of the Elden Ring (a rune) as a gift from Radagon.

nodes.name: Radahn
nodes.base_description: Radahn is a general, son of Radagon and Rennala. He claimed a great rune during the Shattering, held up the stars, and fought Malenia in Caelid. He was afflicted by scarlet rot.

states.current_description: Radahn is a powerful general, son of Radagon and Rennala. He holds up the stars to prevent beasts and sorcerers from accessing forbidden power. He has a great rune.
Radahn is a sickened, rotting shell of his former self, afflicted by Malenia's scarlet rot. He wanders Caelid, driven mad. His followers seek an honorable death for him via a festival.

nodes.name: Rykard
nodes.base_description: Rykard is a Praetor, son of Radagon and Rennala. He rejected the Erdtree and tried to become a god by devouring all.

nodes.name: Ranni
nodes.base_description: Ranni is the Lunar Princess, daughter of Radagon and Rennala. She is an Empyrean who rejected her status, organized the Night of the Black Knives, and had her own body killed to avoid being a vassal to the Greater Will.

states.current_description: Ranni is the Lunar Princess, daughter of Radagon and Rennala. She is an Empyrean chosen by the Two Fingers as a potential successor to Marika. She has her original body.
Ranni is a spirit residing in a doll made to resemble a snow witch, her former mentor. Her original body is dead. She rejected her Empyrean status to avoid becoming a vassal of the Greater Will.

nodes.name: Tarnished
nodes.base_description: The Tarnished are beings banished from the Lands Between because they lack the Greater Will's grace. They later returned.

states.current_description: The Tarnished are banished beings who lack the Greater Will's grace. They are exiled from the Lands Between, including Godfrey as the first.
The Tarnished have returned to the Lands Between. The Greater Will and Two Fingers see them as an opportunity to repair the Elden Ring and restore order.

nodes.name: Malenia
nodes.base_description: Malenia is a daughter of Marika and Radagon, cursed with rot. She served Miquella, marched to Caelid to fight Radahn, and bloomed scarlet rot, devastating Caelid.

states.current_description: Malenia is a daughter of Marika and Radagon, cursed with rot. She serves her brother Miquella and resides at the Haligtree, which Miquella created to cure her.
Malenia marches her Cleanrot Knights to Caelid and battles Radahn. She blooms her scarlet rot, devastating Caelid and afflicting Radahn.
Malenia is comatose after blooming. Her knight Finlay carries her back to the Haligtree. She remains asleep. Miquella is stolen by Mohg while she is unconscious.

nodes.name: Miquella
nodes.base_description: Miquella is a son of Marika and Radagon, cursed with eternal youth. He rejected the Golden Order, created the Haligtree. He is also St. Trina. He was stolen by Mohg.

states.current_description: Miquella is a son of Marika and Radagon, cursed with eternal youth. He rejected the Golden Order and created the Haligtree as a refuge for the discriminated and to cure his sister Malenia. He is also known as St. Trina.
Miquella is stolen by Mohg, who intends to make him a puppet ruler and consort under the Formless Mother. Miquella rejects this and his ambitions do not come to fruition.

nodes.name: Frenzied Flame
nodes.base_description: The Frenzied Flame is an Outer God that desires chaos, using the Three Fingers as its emissary.

nodes.name: Night of the Black Knives
nodes.base_description: The Night of the Black Knives was an event where Ranni organized the theft of the Rune of Death to kill demigods. Godwyn was killed.

nodes.name: Shattering
nodes.base_description: The Shattering is the event where Queen Marika shattered the Elden Ring, leading to her imprisonment and the war between demigods.

base_attributes.time: after the Night of the Black Knives

nodes.name: Shattering War
nodes.base_description: The Shattering War is the war between the demigod children after the shattering of the Elden Ring.
